label: MikroTik Audience
description: Tri-band home mesh access point: three radios (2.4 GHz plus two 5 GHz) and two gigabit ports.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 2x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, passive PoE in; 2.4 GHz max data rate 300 Mbit/s (802.11b/g/n), 5 GHz max 867 Mbit/s (802.11a/n/ac) and a second 5 GHz radio at max 1733 Mbit/s. The third radio is the mesh backhaul, and it is modelled separately because a three-radio AP is not the same lab object as a dual-band one.
